$comment: Source of truth for price groups and channels. Synced into the database on every start.
Change it with a pull request: the AI review and your approval protect these business rules.
costSource: PRODUCT = product master (brand + model/code) | PROJECT = cost per project id | LANDED = imported item, cost calculated from factory price
formula: MULTIPLY = special x (1-d1)(1-d2)(1-d3) | GP_ON_NORMAL = normal x (1-d1)(1-d2)(1-d3) - (normal - special)
indicatorRules: checked in order; 'below' = strictly less than, 'upTo' = less than or equal; anything above the last rule is OKAY
discount: label, default, min, max (fractions, 0.2 = 20%), editable. Non-editable discounts are always the default.
